sloka: श्रृणोमि खगतानां च सिद्धानां चारणैः सह ।राक्षसी सिंहिका भीमा क्षिप्रं हनुमता हता ।। ५.५८.४४ ।।।।
transliteration: śrṛṇomi khagatānāṁ ca siddhānāṁ cāraṇaiḥ saha ।rākṣasī siṁhikā bhīmā kṣipraṁ hanumatā hatā ।। 5.58.44 ।।।।

translations.english: "I heard the charanas and siddhas residing in the sky talking to each other that the fierce ogres Simhika has been killed by Hanuman in a moment.
